mentions.name: AI-assisted aviation regulation compliance tool
mentions.description: An AI-assisted aviation regulation compliance tool for aviation professionals. It currently uses RAG over EU aviation regulations, with plans to add FAA and UK CAA sources and more complex AI agent features for deeper research.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building a AI-assisted aviation regulation compliance tool for aviation professionals: https://aviation.bot
At the moment just a RAG with EU aviation regulations. Soon FAA, UK CAA, and more complex AI agent features that do more complex deep research.
